title: THE SUPERSTAR MODEL PROTOCOL
author: Nico MP
desc: To develop a "leading man" physique—defined by broad shoulders, a dense upper chest, and a razor-tight waist—optimized for both the lens and high-performance sports like surfing and snowboarding.

ex.note: Model Chest Focus. Grip slightly wider than shoulders. Lower bar to 2 inches below collarbone. 3sec descent, explode up. RPT: Rest 3 mins. Set 2 is -10% weight, Set 3 is -10% more.
Inner Pec Detail. Keep a slight 'hug' bend in elbows. Pause for 1sec at the bottom for a deep stretch. Do NOT let dumbbells touch at the top—keep tension on the chest.
Bicep Peak. Set bench to 45 degrees. Let arms hang straight down behind the torso to stretch the long head. Curl up without moving elbows forward. RPT: -5lbs per set.

ss.note: Lateral Head (Width). Rest-Pause: Pick weight for 15-20 reps to failure. Rest 15s. Do 4-5 reps. Rest 15s. Repeat for 4 mini-sets total. Flare the rope ends apart at the bottom.
Lateral Head (Width). Rest-Pause: Pick weight for 15-20 reps to failure. Rest 15s. Do 4-5 reps. Rest 15s. Repeat for 4 mini-sets total. Flare the rope ends apart at the bottom

ex.note: Vascularity/Forearms. Pronated grip (palms down). Keep elbows pinned. Squeeze the top for 1sec. This builds the muscle that pushes the bicep up.
Lower V-Cut. Do NOT swing. Focus on 'rolling' your pelvis toward your chest. Exhale hard at the top to contract the abs.
Surfer/Snowboarder Core. Start in a high plank with shins on the ball. Pull knees to chest by rounding the lower back. Keep shoulders steady.
DO CABLE CRUNCHES IF AVAILABLE. If not hold weight at upper chest. Only go 3/4 of the way up to keep constant tension. Focus on the 'crunch' of the ribs toward the hips.
RPT: If bodyweight is easy, add 5–10 lbs. Drop 10% weight each set.
RPT: Use Barbell or DB. Keep glutes squeezed to protect lower back.

ss.note: Rest-Pause: 15s rest between mini-sets. Use light weight for "pump."
Do these between sets of lateral raises to tighten the waist.

ex.note: Abs Block. Slow tempo. Lift pelvis, not just legs.
Abs Block. Focus on the lower ab crunch.
Abs Block. Constant tension on the upper "bricks."
RPT: Top weight for 8. Drop 5–10 lbs per set.
Pull to forehead; pull rope ends apart.
One foot on bench. DBs at sides. (Leg maintenance).
OPTIONAL ONLY. Alternative: Leg Press 15-20 reps.

Palms down. Focus on the forearm/bicep tie-in.
